traction.notes: 13,000 sq ft Bengaluru lab hosts 25 robot systems; plans to expand to 50+ by 2026
Target deploying 300 robotic systems annually by 2028
Target $45-50M revenue to reach break-even at ~60% gross margins
Robots learn to manipulate unknown objects within 10-15 seconds without pre-training
Configuring new tasks within same setup takes ~1 hour; creating new task from scratch takes 1 week to 3 months
Systems priced between $150,000 and $180,000 plus annual maintenance and development fees

products.name: CyRo
products.description: Dual-arm, vision-guided robotic system for handling unknown objects with human-like dexterity. 18-21 DOF. Powered by real-time perception and force-aware manipulation.

products.name: CyNoid - 7A
products.description: Mobile robotic system with three 7-axis arms (7-DOF) for complex tasks in tight spaces.

products.name: Mantroid
products.description: Three-wheeled robotic system with height adjustability and extended reach for logistics and retrieval tasks.

products.name: CLX1 Vision Stack
products.description: Intelligence stack that perceives unseen objects and breaks them into geometry, texture, reflectance, and grasp possibilities. Uses event imaging, liquid lens optics, optical convergence, temporal imaging, hierarchical depth mapping.

products.name: Object Intelligence Platform
products.description: Commercial-ready OI platform enabling robots to learn and manipulate unknown objects within seconds. Research collaboration with IISc.

products.name: Object Computers
products.description: Vision-enabled systems granting robots true perception to adapt on the fly to any product without pre-training.
